purpose: Annotation-selected development-validation feasibility cases only; not a representative cohort or test-set policy calibration
selection: First four positives sorted by (n_ref, case_id), first two negatives sorted by case_id; no prediction outcomes used in this selection
availability: Six public CTs and paired combined/individual lesion labels staged locally outside Git; hashes/counts/header geometry pass. Original-archive byte identity, trained preprocessing and checkpoint/GPU parity remain unverified. Do not submit on this manifest alone.
gates: Verify raw CT and GT case IDs, hashes and geometry, actual split membership, and trained preprocessing before execution.
Preserve full volume context; no GT crop. Keep all selected cases even if deepest model performs poorly.
Use only supervised UNet++ DS-on branches j2 through j5; no unsupervised j1.
Report absolute deepest-model recall and FP burden, additional misses and all heads; no clinical safety inference from four positives.
No protected 901-case evaluation reads, changes, or policy fitting.
